pairs.why: The two are almost the same; the wood, leather and gold badge have the same finish, and neither is clearly closer to the soft, smooth real cards.
B's leather and wood read a little smoother and softer, like the real book and map cards, while A's surface grain is slightly busier.
The two are practically identical in build, light and finish.
A's leather is slightly smoother and matte, while B's black leather has a slightly brighter sheen along its edges.
B's wallet has a glossier, shinier lit edge and pebbly leather, while A's smoother, softer finish is closer to the real cards.
The two are near-duplicates, with no visible difference in rendering, shape or finish.
